question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**paving**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence structure suggests that the blank requires a present participle (verb+ing) to maintain grammatical accuracy.
 
• "**Paving**" correctly fits the context, as it indicates the continuous process of creating opportunities for the development of algebra, algorithms, and calculus.
 
• "**Has been paved**" and "**Have paved**" are incorrect because they are passive and do not fit the active construction of the sentence.
 
• "**Was paved**" is incorrect as it implies a completed action in the past, whereas the sentence describes an ongoing influence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.
